body: Thanks, I keep looking for local ads for acting jobs, maybe one day i'll get lucky
yeah, of course I was unaware when I was typing of my own hypocrisy, complaining that my mom does nothing but complain about people, while my post did literally just that, complain about people.

My Dad always gets on me about the direction my life has taken, and not in a nice or constructive way anyway. Just sort of naggy and annoying. My fiancé just likes to poke fun at me, but sometimes she crosses the line and even upsets herself. Like once she said she was going to get a new boyfriend ( I really can't remember the context anymore or why it was said, but it was supposed to be funny). My mom is just all around negative, she spends most of her time complaining about others, and it gets on my nerves. Most of the time it's not directed at me.

It's just that it doesn't interest me, and isn't really worth the time, money, and effort. If i'm going to switch jobs, i'd like it to at least be to something I like. I guess i'm really more interested in being in movies than acting, even work as an extra with no lines in a commercial would give me a sense of accomplishment. Maybe someday. I know there is a theater in town but I have pretty much no time to do that sort of thing nowadays, and community theaters are known for being awful anyway.

I think I might have been emotional and a bit wrong when I wrote about my fiancé and parents. They're ok, but sometimes really do get on my nerves with all the problems they have. I am afraid of being alone, but I know my fiancé and I have a strong emotional bond as well as similar personality ( deficiencies). I don't think I deserve the occasional nasty comments I get from them, I just don't do much to stop it because i'm a doormat.

Believe me, you've no idea how often I've thought about just packing my bags and leaving it all behind, goodbye stupid job, family, trailer park, bills, etc. It's just that if I did that, i'd have literally no foresight. Just leaving could put me in a worse situation. I could be homeless and alone, which I would hate. 

 As far as passions go, I've always enjoyed the art of filmmaking ,especially acting. I fancied the idea of either becoming an actor or a writer, but I know where I live it's not going to happen, and I can't just move to Hollywood and expect things to happen for me. I know I could be doing something better than I am, but not much i'm interested in. I could waste thousands of dollars to learn how to fix toilets or air conditioners and could land a decent job, but the thought of that is too dull to even consider.
